title: KS-Groupoids and KS-Crossed Products associated with Inverse Semigroup Actions
summary: For an action of an inverse semigroup $S$ on a locally compact Hausdorff space $X$, we construct an étale groupoid $S\ltimes X^\mathrm{KS}$, called the KS-groupoid associated with the action. This construction may be viewed as a dynamical analogue of the construction of universal groupoids for inverse semigroups. We provide a dynamical version of Paterson's theorem which states that the full and reduced crossed products (in the sense of Khoshkam and Skandalis) of $C_0(X)$ are canonically isomorphic to the full and reduced groupoid C*-algebras of $S\ltimes X^\mathrm{KS}$, respectively.
